milestone: WP-01 reported file data ranges with explicit held-object access
build_interpretation: Mac final 2-step fixture rebuild (3.376s) follows a 4-step core update (1.078s) and broad 54-step rebuild (18.102s); initial broad 52-step build took 19.573s. Inputs were hash-verified, not inferred from elapsed time.

Linux final build completed 43 remaining Ninja steps after GCC diagnosed a copied range-loop pair; changed to const reference. Failed driver stopped before CTest. Final current manifest and both executable hashes are recorded.
Windows final five-step rebuild (8.765s) follows a successful initial broad rebuild; current manifest verified before build. Native ReFS query passed on this workstation.

Focused builds compile all 27 core units, native platform adapter, six fixtures and host (35 units) without object caches. Mac comparable preliminary build: 65.263s; final 65.882s. Windows final: 69.694s. Linux first successful baseline for this fixture set: 151.535s; different fixture sets are not identical timing baselines.

rejected_attempts.reason: APFS ftruncate allocated the entire fixture. Sparse assertion failed; its printed qualification marker is excluded. Corrected fixture punches only known-zero test ranges with F_PUNCHHOLE, fsyncs, and retains sparse allocation assertion.
GCC -Werror=range-loop-construct rejected copied pointer pair. Changed to const reference; warnings remain errors. No tests from failed build accepted.

guarantees: Read-only range observation requires explicit MetadataAndLayout access; metadata-only calls remain denied.

Darwin seeks original event-only descriptor. Linux obtains permission-checked read handle via held descriptor in verified procfs. Windows uses native ID open while original handle is live; no basename fallback or elevation.
Reported family, held owner, logical size and bounded sorted ranges retained; failures/cancellation/limits never publish a prefix.
Queries inspect before/after identity/kind/size and available change times; provider guards and explicit permission failures remain visible.
Inventory collection accounts for layout records/bytes incrementally and resumes interrupted queries without repeating completed families.
limitations: Potential-data ranges are not physical extents, exact allocation, actual nonzero bytes, a snapshot, clone/dedup relationships, sparse preservation or copy permission.
Linux lacks generic provider-locality proof; read-access opt-in does not promise universal no-hydration.
Native calls can block; cancellation is cooperative between calls.
Native filesystem qualification is case-sensitive APFS, Linux ext4 and Windows ReFS only; no universal filesystem claim.

WP-01 remains open; initial selection, self/descendant checks, native equivalence, operation capabilities, remaining inventories and pane/worker/large-view integration still required. No GUI or production mutations introduced.
